title: Audit unused campaign-rule position/status indexes
description: Assess migration 0025 indexes campaign_rule_effective_position and campaign_rule_status_position. The current active-rule read paths fetch all rows by campaign_id and evaluate effective/revoked/superseded positions in JavaScript, so these two indexes appear unused. Decide whether to retain, replace, or remove them in a future migration after measuring query plans and any restore/checkpoint implications; do not modify merged migration 0025 in the current fix.
acceptance_criteria: Record EXPLAIN/query-plan evidence for current reads and a reviewed decision for both indexes; if removal or replacement is warranted, add a separate forward migration and regression coverage.
notes: Discovered during eshyra-jhpt.rev7 round-4 review; intentionally not changed in commit 818517d.
